ruleName: Ball Lost or Out of Bounds: Stroke-and-Distance Relief; Ball Provisional
imagePrompt: Create a modern, polished illustration in a semi-realistic, slightly stylised style (about 75% realistic, 25% stylised) showing the edge of a golf fairway and a white painted line on the ground marking the out of bounds boundary. A single golfer, seen side-on, is looking closely at a golf ball lying very near but not touching the white line. The surroundings should make it clear this is the boundary area of a hole. Do not include text, labels, numbers, arrows, captions, diagrams, badges, logos, watermarks, club crests, scorecards or speech bubbles.
imageAlt: A golfer closely examining a golf ball near a white painted line marking the boundary at the edge of the fairway.

sceneSpec.setting: Edge of a golf hole where the fairway meets the boundary
sceneSpec.players: One golfer shown looking towards the boundary line
sceneSpec.ballPosition: A golf ball placed just inside the white boundary line, with the line clearly visible
sceneSpec.ruleMoment: Moment where the golfer is assessing if the ball is in or out of bounds based on the line
sceneSpec.educationalFocus: Clarifies where the boundary is when defined by a white painted line on the ground
mustShow: White painted line clearly visible on the ground forming the boundary
Golf ball lying very close to but not touching the white line
Golfer observing the ball and line from nearby

questions.title: Where is Out of Bounds When There Is a White Line?
questions.question: If there is a white line on the ground to show out of bounds, what counts as out of bounds?

choices.text: The edge of the line farthest from the golf course.
The whole white line is out of bounds.
The edge of the line closest to the golf course.

questions.explanation: If a white line marks out of bounds, the whole line is out of bounds. If your ball touches the line or is past it, it is out of bounds.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A place where you are not allowed to play and must play a new ball.
The line or mark that tells you where out of bounds starts.

questions.teachingTip: Show some pictures or make a white line on the practice ground to help kids see what counts as out of bounds.
likelyMisconceptions: Some players may think only past the line is out of bounds, not the line itself.
Kids may think only the edge or centre of the line counts, but the whole line is out of bounds.

questions.title: Identifying the Boundary from a White Line
questions.question: A boundary is defined by a white line on the ground. Where is the boundary?

choices.text: The outside edge of the line.
The line itself is out of bounds.
The inside edge of the line.

questions.explanation: When a boundary is defined by a white line on the ground, the line itself (including its thickness) is out of bounds. Anything touching or beyond the line is considered out of bounds.
